questions.question_text: Which garden tool is primarily used for turning the soil and breaking up large dirt clods before planting seeds?
Fill in the blank: A ________ is a simple machine consisting of a grooved wheel and a rope, used to lift heavy objects easily.
What is the primary function of adding compost to a school kitchen garden?
options: B) To make the plants grow taller instantly
C) To enrich the soil with natural nutrients
D) To change the color of the flowers
questions.answer: C) To enrich the soil with natural nutrients

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: What is 'mulching' in gardening, and why is it useful? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Mulching is covering the soil around plants with materials like dry leaves or straw. It is useful because it helps retain soil moisture and prevents weed growth.

questions.question_text: Define an 'inclined plane' and give one real-life example used in schools. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An inclined plane is a flat supporting surface tilted at an angle, used to help move heavy loads up or down. A wheelchair ramp at school is a common example.

questions.question_text: List two important details you should note down when documenting a new bird species in a Biodiversity Register. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: When documenting a new bird species, you should note its physical appearance (like colors and size) and the specific time and location where it was spotted.

questions.question_text: Your class is building a small model crane using Maker Skills. Describe how you would use cardboard, string, and a spool to demonstrate how a pulley works. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: I would attach the spool to the top of a strong cardboard frame using a pencil as an axle. Then, I would thread the string over the spool, attaching a small load to one end. Pulling the other end easily lifts the load, demonstrating a working pulley.
